text: {"hierarchy": 6, "layout_spacing": 6, "typography": 5, "color_contrast": 5, "consistency": 6, "overall": 5, "reason": "The collage-style vlog story graphic has a clear focal photo and playful gold star accents, but the white-on-gray 'new vlog' text and small, low-contrast 'swipe up' label weaken readability, and the footer's claim of WCAG AAA compliance is not supported by the visible contrast."}
